backtest.headline: 11/11 spotted early, median 21 months before the first funding announcement or database entry (range 8–40 months; n=11, hand-picked known spin-offs, see selection bias below)
bias: Survivorship: the reference list only contains companies that later became known and raised money. It measures how early the signal appears for winners, not how many EXIST projects become winners (precision) – that is what precision.py with hand labels is for.

Name bias: only companies whose name appears in the EXIST project title were included. Companies whose project had a different name are not found, so the hit rate N/M is biased upwards. At the same time this is exactly the case the pipeline already covers without website matching.

Catalogue delay: the signal date is the project start. When the entry actually became public in the Förderkatalog is not archived (no Wayback for detail pages); realistically weeks to months later. The lead time is therefore an upper bound by that delay.

Database date: Wayback archives Crunchbase/Dealroom patchily; the first capture is an upper bound for when the profile appeared. The first funding announcement is therefore also used, and the earlier of the two counts.
Small sample (n<=13), hand-researched, mostly TUM/Munich (press density). Median instead of mean; individual values are listed per company.
No pipeline replay: today's sourcing only reads projects from 2024 on. The backtest applies the same mapping (map_project, priority) to the historical catalogue rows, but not context and scoring.

best_find.name: Ymolution
best_find.intro: Spin-off of University Medicine Greifswald. Ymolution produces nano-antibodies without animal testing, from synthetic gene libraries in a bacterial system.

timeline.signal: EXIST Research Transfer starts, EUR 853,134, until 30.06.2026 (our signal)
Innovation Award of the German BioRegions, first project from Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania
Ymolution founded (GmbH). University Medicine Greifswald is a shareholder, by its own account for the first time in a spin-off (press release of 14.01.2026)

State funding Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, about EUR 1.34m for a joint research project of University Medicine and Ymolution (new approaches in cancer therapy). Date taken from the page timestamp of the report (Brave API page_age; the page itself blocks WebFetch). Ymolution's share open. Public money, no equity
Imprint: Ymolution GmbH, Greifswald, HRB 23103 AG Stralsund, managing directors Dr. Alexander Reder, Dr. Christian Hentschker

Website: „Wir suchen strategische Investoren und institutionelle Partner für die Finanzierungsrunde 2026“ ("We are looking for strategic investors and institutional partners for the 2026 financing round")

Funding: still only public money (EXIST, state of MV) plus University Medicine as shareholder. No VC or angel report found (counter-searches 21.11.2026), no archived Crunchbase/Dealroom profile in Wayback

best_find.team: Dr. Alexander Reder, Dr. Christian Hentschker, Marc Schaffer, Jan Meiering.
best_find.why_now: The GmbH has existed since January 2026, EXIST funding ended on 30.06.2026, and according to its own website the investor search for 2026 is under way. The state funding from late October 2026 lowers the research risk but does not replace equity. A platform for research reagents, diagnostics and therapy addresses a large antibody market. Greifswald is far from the VC hubs, so competition for the deal should be low.
best_find.open: No paper or patent on the method found. Clarify the business model (service or platform) and University Medicine's stake.

rejected.name: InhalPlus
rejected.reason: Fraunhofer ITEM spin-off (aerosol therapy for premature infants, InhalPlus GmbH incorporated on 27.08.2026). On 16.10.2026 NBank Capital invested EUR 500,000 pre-seed as the first external investor (https://startupvalley.news/de/inhalplus-fruehgeborenen-nbank-capital/). Profiles on nordic9 and VCBacked already exist. So the company comes too late for "Best Find". For the pitch it still proves the signal works: EXIST start 01.12.2024, first funding 16.10.2026, a lead of a good 22 months.
